title: Quinoa Upma
subtitle: A complete-protein upma, tempered with mustard seed and curry leaf.
meta: Night prep: rinse and soak quinoa
protein: ~20–24g protein per adult serving — quinoa is a complete protein

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Rinse quinoa thoroughly in cold water until it runs clear (removes saponin bitterness)
Soak 15–20 min, drain, refrigerate — cuts morning cook time

method.title: Tempering
items: Heat ghee {2 tbsp} in a heavy pan on medium
Add mustard seeds {1 tsp} — splutter; add cumin seeds {½ tsp}
Add hing {¼ tsp}, curry leaves {8–10}, cashews {10} — stir 30 sec
Add capsicum {½ cup} and tomato {1 medium}; cook 2 min
Add peas {¼ cup}, turmeric {¼ tsp}, salt {to taste}; stir

method.label: Toddler — pull portion here
items: Scoop out vegetables {3–4 tbsp} before adding chili to the main pan
Add water {⅓ cup} and rinsed quinoa {3 tbsp} to a small pan with her vegetables
Cover and cook on low 12 min until quinoa is soft and water absorbed
Mash lightly if needed; add a drop of ghee

method.title: Add chili and cook quinoa
items: Add green chili {1–2} to the adult pan; cook 20 sec
Add remaining quinoa {rest of the 1 cup} to the tempering pan; stir to coat 1 min
Add water {1¾ cups} and bring to a boil
Reduce to low; cover and cook 12–14 min until water absorbed and quinoa tails appear
Rest covered 5 min; fluff with fork
Finish with lemon juice {1 tsp} and coriander {2 tbsp}

method.label: Tip
method.text: The white "tail" curling out of each quinoa grain means it's cooked. Don't skip the 5-minute covered rest — it makes the texture fluffy rather than sticky.
